map.由经营现金流与资本支出求自由现金流 使用指南: Free cash flow from operating cash flow and capex user guide
map.自由现金流(FCF)计算器，输入经营现金流与资本支出，按 FCF=OCF−资本支: Free cash flow (FCF) calculator: enter operating cash flow and capital expenditure to get freely disposable cash as FCF = OCF - capex, for corporate valuation and dividend capacity analysis.
map.输入经营现金流与资本支出，求自由现金流。: Enter operating cash flow and capital expenditure to get free cash flow.
map.填写「经营现金流 OCF (万元)」。: Enter the 'operating cash flow OCF (10k CNY)'.
map.衡量企业在维持资产基础后可分配给债权人与股东的现金。: Measures the cash a company can distribute to creditors and shareholders after maintaining its asset base.
map.DCF 估值的核心输入，预测未来 FCF 折现得到企业价值。: A core input of DCF valuation: forecast future FCF and discount it to obtain enterprise value.
map.监控主业是否真正产生可自由支配现金，而非仅账面盈利。: Monitor whether the core business really generates freely disposable cash, rather than only book profit.
map.：某公司经营现金流 500 万元，当年资本性支出 200 万元，自由现金流=50: : A company with operating cash flow of 5,000,000 CNY and capital expenditure of 2,000,000 CNY for the year has free cash flow = 5,000,000 - 2,000,000 = 3,000,000 CNY, that is the cash freely available after maintaining operations and expansion.
map.由营收与营业成本求毛利: Gross profit from revenue and cost of sales
map.由 EBIT 与利息费用求保障倍数: Coverage ratio from EBIT and interest expense
map.由存货与营业成本求存货天数: Inventory days from inventory and cost of sales
map.为什么 FCF 比净利润更真实？: Why is FCF more realistic than net profit?
map.净利润含应计项目与非付现折旧，可能盈利却缺现金；FCF 扣除维持资产所需的资本支: Net profit includes accruals and non-cash depreciation, so a company can be profitable yet short of cash; FCF deducts the capital expenditure needed to maintain assets and reflects the cash truly available for dividends or debt repayment.
map.指购建固定资产、无形资产及其他长期资产的现金流出，是维持与扩大产能的必要投入；研: Refers to cash outflows for acquiring or constructing fixed assets, intangible assets and other long-term assets - the necessary investment to maintain and expand capacity; capitalized R&D may also be included.
